alternate_valid_findings: A grounded distinct custom on_json_loading_failed, body-consumption, encoding or public JSONMixin coverage gap can be accepted without triggering a control false alarm.

A concern about response-side coverage may be accepted if the report proves materially different response behavior; the shared JSONMixin means missing a response spelling alone is not a demonstrated regression gap.

contracts.contract: silent silences parse errors and returns None; absent silence, failed parsing delegates to on_json_loading_failed, whose default raises BadRequest. cache stores parsed JSON.
Default request wrapper and hooks/view execution belong to the request lifecycle.
A request context holds the request instance used by hooks and view code.
Published API autodoc includes Request methods and attributes.

limitations: Source-only: no target imports, tests, discovery, build, install, Docker, or execution occurred.
Each packet is a bounded selection of complete raw upstream files, not a runnable checkout. External dependencies and unrelated modules are absent.
Contracts, production callers, related tests and root test configuration are visible. Authoritative history and exact fixed-parent relations remain sealed from auditors.
Each packet is internally from one exact upstream commit. No authored target code, excerpt substitutions, injected comments, issue summaries, diffs, or targeted failure prompts are in packets.
Fixed controls deliberately include upstream regression assertions, while pre-fix twins naturally do not; the comparison uses identical packets across skill arms.
Public historical cases may have appeared in model training. Prior familiarity cannot be excluded, and packets disclose project identity through their unmodified contents.
Blinding is an instructed filesystem boundary, not an OS-enforced sandbox. Auditors must receive only one staged packet and must not browse history, sibling packets, rubric, or oracle.
Only the permitted prior protocol was inspected for exclusions. Prior audit outputs and the revised skill were not read.
Control means protected against the declared historical interaction, not proven defect-free or immune to other material test gaps.
oracle_challenges: The silent cache index assumes the documented boolean silent input; arbitrary integers or custom objects are outside the declared parameter contract unless the report establishes a supported caller.
Two entries fix the accepted interaction, not every conceivable combination of force, cache, custom loaders or body reads.
protected_evidence: flask/wrappers.py:26,63-64 stores two cache entries indexed by silent; failed silent parsing updates only the silent entry, and successful parsing fills both.
tests/test_helpers.py:65-71 test_different_silent_on_bad_request supplies malformed application/json, calls silent=True and then silent=False with default caching, and asserts BadRequest.
tests/test_helpers.py:73-78 test_different_silent_on_normal_request checks that valid JSON results remain shared across both policies with identity and content assertions.
Existing test_ignore_cached_json still protects the cache=False alternate path.
protected_false_alarms: Claiming silent cached None still causes default non-silent parsing to return None for the malformed application/json sequence.
Claiming all tests force cache=False for the second non-silent parse or never exercise mixed silent settings with default caching.
Treating valid JSON null returning None or successful-result identity sharing as a defect.
